parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$s=\int(t^2-8t^{3/2}+10t)\,dt$ — *M1.
$s=\dfrac13t^3-\dfrac{16}{5}t^{5/2}+5t^2+C$ — A1. Guidance: Allow unsimplified.
Correct use of correct limits — DM1. Guidance: Use of limit at $t=0$ may be implied.
Displacement $=2.13$ m (3 sf) — A1. Guidance: Allow $\dfrac{32}{15}$ m.
Total: 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Attempt to differentiate $v$ — *M1.
$a=2t-12t^{1/2}+10$ — A1. Guidance: Allow unsimplified.
$a=0\Rightarrow2t-12t^{1/2}+10=0$; set $a=0$ and attempt to solve their 3-term equation in $t$, $\sqrt t$ or $p=\sqrt t$ by treating it as a quadratic — DM1 dependent on *M1.
$2(\sqrt t-5)(\sqrt t-1)=0$, leading to $t=1$ or $t=25$ — A1. Guidance: Both correct.
$\dfrac{da}{dt}=2-6t^{-1/2}$; determine the nature of the stationary point by differentiating $a$ and testing the sign, or substituting values either side of their $t$ value(s) — *DM1 dependent on *M1. If using $da/dt$, it must be evaluated at a $t$ value; allow any $t$ value from their quadratic.
Use $t=25$ in $da/dt=2-6t^{-1/2}$, evaluating correctly and hence a minimum — A1. Guidance: Or use a convincing argument that $t=25$ gives a minimum; if evaluated, $da/dt$ must be $0.8$.
Minimum velocity $=25^2-8(25)^{3/2}+10(25)=-125\text{ m s}^{-1}$ — B1 AG. Guidance: Award only if the previous 6 marks are awarded.
Total: 7.
